beats.text: Five phrases emotionally intelligent people use without even thinking.
One. 'Help me understand.' It turns a clash into curiosity, instantly.
Two. 'That's a fair point.' Conceding something small costs nothing and builds trust.
Three. 'I feel this, when that happens.' Owning the feeling instead of blaming the person.
Four. 'I don't know — let's find out.' Comfortable not having every answer.
Five. 'Let me think about that.' A pause, instead of a reaction they'll regret.
Emotional intelligence isn't saying clever things. It's making the other person feel safe to be honest.
